description: Discover a bounded page of fields, descriptions, accepted aliases, allowed filter operators, coded values and coverage definitions. Search zip or zip_code for the canonical zip5 field. State publishes two-letter codes and full-name labels; either input is accepted. Defaults to filterable audience fields; use purpose=enrichment for all output fields. feature_store fields are enrichment-only unless also tagged audience. Follow next_cursor for more fields; for more enum values pass field_name and values_next_cursor as value_cursor. Subscription capacity rates are opt-in. Requires discovery scope. Requires 'discovery' scope.

cursor.description: next_cursor returned by the previous page

field_name.description: Retrieve one exact field, including a page of its coded values

limit.description: Maximum fields per page; response size may shorten the page

purpose.description: Default filter: show fields usable for population filters. Use enrichment for all selectable output fields. Explicit product_usage, template_id or field_name overrides this default.

search.description: Case-insensitive search across field names, accepted aliases, labels and descriptions

template_id.description: Show fields in this delivery template

value_cursor.description: values_next_cursor from a field; requires field_name

value_limit.description: Maximum enum values per field; defaults to 100 for one field or 25 in a list

name: get_field_catalog

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

fields.description: Selectable output fields; audience filtering remains audience-tagged only

default_text_comparison.description: Exact by default for supported text comparisons; null otherwise

enum_values.description: Exact request values, not display labels

groupable.description: May be used as a group_by/crosstab dimension

text_comparison_modes.description: Supported comparison modes for text filter values; empty for non-text fields

trim_whitespace_supported.description: Whether filter values can request trimming of outer whitespace

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

pricing.description: Organization subscription capacity rates when requested; otherwise null

templates.description: Templates; request template_id to page their fields

title: Browse Field Catalog
